title: Lore Instructions
description: Ingram's own words, 2026-09-13: 'if I want a mass edit of a document I don't have to edit everything myself I can instead write a description of a change I want to a document and you will do that work for me.' The reverse of tools/gazetteer/core/requests.py's Claude-to-Ingram queue -- this is Ingram-to-Claude, attached to a specific lore-library document. An instruction on an importance-1 document is a real fork: apply it if it is genuinely unambiguous, otherwise resolve it with status 'needs-clarification' and ask in chat rather than guessing (see design/location-rank.md's rank-1 rule and the same standing caution extended to documents in lore-library.schema.json). Consumed by tools/gazetteer/core/lore_library.py.

documentId.description: A lore-library.json document id -- the file this instruction applies to.

text.description: Ingram's own words describing the change wanted. Never rewritten or summarised when logged -- kept verbatim so intent survives even if the edit that follows needs a second pass.

resolution.description: One line on what was actually done -- or, for 'needs-clarification', what question was asked instead of guessing.
